name: Animated Parlor
disable: DC 44 Deception check, DC 44 Diplomacy check, or DC 44 Intimidation check (expert) to convince the items to stop attacking, DC 40 Occultism check or DC 40 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the soul fragments in the items; four total successes are required to disable the hazard
reset: The hazard resets 1 hour after it has been disabled. If destroyed, the hazard doesn't reset until Zyphaniss refurnishes the room, a project that takes several weeks.
routine: (4 actions) On each action, the hazard makes an animated object Strike against a different creature in the room. For each successful check made to disable the hazard, the haunt has 1 fewer action.

items.name: Come to Life
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on, touches, or otherwise interacts with the carpet

---
Effect The room's furnishings animate and begin flying about the chamber. Any creature in the area takes 2d12 bludgeoning,2d12 piercing,2d12 fire,2d12 slashing damage, with a DC 40 basic Reflex save save. On a critical failure, the creature is also knocked Prone. The hazard rolls initiative.

text: The items in the room, from the knick-knacks on the shelves to the logs burning in the fireplace, come to life and attack all creatures in the room.
